SaveSlotServiceClient.luau.description: Client-side save-slot metadata, selection, and lazy read-only active-slot API. Inactive slot contents remain server-only. Public entry points include `invokeMutationAsync`, `SaveSlotServiceClient.Init`, `SaveSlotServiceClient.Start`, `SaveSlotServiceClient.ReadyAsync`, `SaveSlotServiceClient.GetActiveSlotData`, `SaveSlotServiceClient.GetActiveSlotDataAsync`, `SaveSlotServiceClient.GetValueAsync`,…

Shared/SaveSlotConstants.luau.description: Constants shared by SaveSlotService and SaveSlotServiceClient.

Shared/SaveSlotNetwork.luau.description: ByteNet transport for player-owned save-slot mutations and the local player's active-slot mirror. Inactive slot contents remain server-only.

Shared/SaveSlotSerializationUtils.luau.description: Schema-based serialization for SaveSlot network payloads. Public entry points include `getActiveSlotDataSchema`, `toU32`, `guidToBuffer`, `bufferToGuid`, `SaveSlotSerializationUtils.serializeSlotState`, `SaveSlotSerializationUtils.deserializeSlotState`, `SaveSlotSerializationUtils.serializeActiveSlotData`, `SaveSlotSerializationUtils.deserializeActiveSlotData`.

Shared/SaveSlotUtils.luau.description: Pure helpers for SaveSlot data and paths. Public entry points include `SaveSlotUtils.isSlotId`, `SaveSlotUtils.toOptionalSlotId`, `SaveSlotUtils.isDataPath`, `SaveSlotUtils.getSlotPath`, `SaveSlotUtils.getSlotList`, `SaveSlotUtils.getSlotMetadata`, `SaveSlotUtils.getSlotIdFromIndex`.
